title: I Actually Pocketed It Unisex Tee
tagline: For the moment a sale actually lands in your pocket.
desc: A soft unisex tee that reads “I actually pocketed it,” with a stitched pocket and a couple of receipts peeking out. Made for online sellers, resellers and anyone who has watched fees eat a payday and still come out ahead. Original Pocketed artwork, no marketplace logos.
specs: 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (heather colors are cotton/poly blends)
Direct-to-garment print; colors can shift slightly from screen to fabric
Wash cold inside out, tumble dry low
